scope: Reusable family triggers applied to all 96 individually authored business profiles. Exclusions concern the stated operating role and must be reopened when entity or transaction facts differ.

rules.applicability_trigger: An entity must select a reporting basis before recording transactions or presenting statements.
rules.exclusion_condition: A NAICS activity alone does not determine GAAP, IFRS, GASB, FASAB or tax basis.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A public hospital provider is not a governmental reporting entity merely because it serves Medicare patients.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity has period-end postings, reconciliations or cut-off tasks.
rules.exclusion_condition: A subsector label without a ledger, reporting period or close event is insufficient.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A museum admission profile does not establish which ledger balances exist or who approves close.

rules.applicability_trigger: A transaction includes uncertainty in amount, timing, collectability, useful life or obligation.
rules.exclusion_condition: Routine fixed-price cash settlement with no estimate population does not trigger estimate analysis.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration
rules.scope_counterexample: A clinic claim denial reserve is conditional on payer evidence; a cash ticket sale may not be.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity is preparing statements, disclosures or digital filing for a specified reporting framework.
rules.exclusion_condition: A business activity classification cannot select statement format or disclosure requirements.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction
rules.scope_counterexample: A city regulator and a private regulator have different reporting authority despite similar inspection work.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity has a foreign-currency transaction, balance or foreign operation.
rules.exclusion_condition: Domestic transactions settled entirely in functional currency do not trigger foreign-currency analysis.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A Texas restaurant serving foreign tourists has no foreign operation solely from customer nationality.

rules.applicability_trigger: A policy, estimate, standard adoption or prior-period error affects a specified reporting period.
rules.exclusion_condition: A new activity without a changed policy, adoption event or error evidence is not enough.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A new hospital department is not automatically an accounting-policy change.

rules.applicability_trigger: Events after period end or liquidity/operating facts raise going-concern or subsequent-event questions.
rules.exclusion_condition: A stable operation with no post-period event or financial-distress indicator does not trigger the specialized analysis.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration
rules.scope_counterexample: A grant restriction is not itself a going-concern conclusion.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity controls, is controlled by, or has a reporting-perimeter relationship with another legal entity.
rules.exclusion_condition: Shared customers, referrals or a management contract without control evidence do not establish consolidation.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A hotel manager supplying staff may operate the facility but need not own or control the property entity.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity transfers goods, services, access, tickets, lodging, care or other promised outputs to a customer or payer.
rules.exclusion_condition: Appropriations, donor gifts or custodial receipts are not automatically customer revenue.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration
rules.scope_counterexample: A shelter per-diem claim and a donor-restricted gift require different source and condition analysis.

rules.applicability_trigger: A contract has uncompleted construction, engineering, software, research or other deliverables with accumulated costs.
rules.exclusion_condition: A completed point-of-sale service or pure agency commission without project costs does not create WIP.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A repair work order with no material unperformed obligation may remain ordinary service revenue.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity acquires goods or services and owes vendors or subcontractors.
rules.exclusion_condition: Customer-owned goods held for repair are not provider purchases or payables merely because they are on premises.
required_facts: title/ownership, custody location, unit/lot and valuation evidence
rules.scope_counterexample: A clinic implant consumed for a patient is a clinical inventory issue; a vendor invoice still requires separate evidence.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity has billed or contractually collectible amounts exposed to denial, default, refund or credit risk.
rules.exclusion_condition: Cash-only transactions with no receivable or contract claim do not trigger credit-loss analysis.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration
rules.scope_counterexample: A government appropriation is not a trade receivable absent an enforceable claim.

rules.applicability_trigger: The operation receives, holds, deposits or disburses cash, card, platform, wager or trust settlement.
rules.exclusion_condition: Noncash accrual with no payment or custody event does not trigger settlement controls.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: Casino chips and hospital patient remittances are different settlement populations.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity owns goods for sale, production, consumption or distribution, or holds goods requiring inventory-like controls.
rules.exclusion_condition: Customer-owned repair goods, museum collections and wagers are not provider inventory without ownership facts.
required_facts: title/ownership, custody location, unit/lot and valuation evidence
rules.scope_counterexample: A laundry holds customer garments in custody; detergent stock is its inventory.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity controls long-lived tangible assets or construction in progress used in operations or stewardship.
rules.exclusion_condition: A leased or customer-owned asset without control is not automatically the entity’s capital asset.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction
rules.scope_counterexample: A hospital’s patient implant is not its capital asset; imaging equipment may be.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity has an identified asset conveyed for use or provides a controlled property/right-of-use arrangement.
rules.exclusion_condition: A service contract without an identified controlled asset is not automatically a lease.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction
rules.scope_counterexample: A hotel management agreement may be a service arrangement; the hotel lease requires separate control facts.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity acquires, develops or controls identifiable software, technology, IP or research outputs.
rules.exclusion_condition: General know-how, customer data access or a licensed right without control does not automatically create an owned intangible.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction
rules.scope_counterexample: A 533 software publisher’s licensed code differs from a clinic’s subscription access.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity employs or directs workers and incurs wages, withholding, benefits or job/program labor cost.
rules.exclusion_condition: A customer’s staff or independent vendor labor is not the entity’s payroll without employer/control facts.
required_facts: legal employer, worker classification, time/benefit population and cost object
rules.scope_counterexample: A school contractor that only manages without operating staff is not classified like a staffed school.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity promises or contributes employee retirement, leave, health or termination benefits.
rules.exclusion_condition: A vendor invoice or volunteer relationship does not create employee-benefit accounting absent employer facts.
required_facts: legal employer, worker classification, time/benefit population and cost object
rules.scope_counterexample: A nonprofit volunteer is not automatically an employee benefit population.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity borrows, issues, guarantees or modifies financing with principal, interest or covenant terms.
rules.exclusion_condition: Trade payables without financing terms do not become debt solely from delayed payment.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A grant repayment clause is not debt without financing or enforceable borrowing terms.

rules.applicability_trigger: An entity issues, repurchases or modifies ownership interests or complex capital instruments.
rules.exclusion_condition: Government appropriations, donor restrictions and customer deposits are not equity interests.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A nonprofit membership payment is not equity merely because members vote.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity grants equity or equity-linked awards for employee or service-provider work.
rules.exclusion_condition: Cash wages, vendor discounts and public grants without an equity instrument do not trigger this family.
required_facts: legal employer, worker classification, time/benefit population and cost object
rules.scope_counterexample: A freelance artist commission is not share compensation absent an award.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity holds financial assets or investments outside ordinary operating receivables.
rules.exclusion_condition: A patient receivable, inventory or customer deposit is not an investment solely because it earns a balance.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction
rules.scope_counterexample: A university endowment and a hospital claim receivable require different classification facts.

rules.applicability_trigger: A contract’s value changes with an underlying rate, price, index, currency or other variable and requires settlement analysis.
rules.exclusion_condition: A fixed-price purchase order without an underlying-variable feature is not a derivative merely because it has a future date.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A catering volume commitment is not a derivative absent an underlying-variable net-settlement feature.

rules.applicability_trigger: An asset or liability requires fair-value measurement or impairment testing because of a market, use, credit or recoverability event.
rules.exclusion_condition: NAICS title, management intent or a price estimate alone does not establish fair-value or impairment scope.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction
rules.scope_counterexample: A museum collection stewardship issue differs from hotel property impairment.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity controls or holds a token, cryptocurrency or tokenized right with identifiable contractual and custody facts.
rules.exclusion_condition: A conventional bank balance, loyalty point or ordinary database record is not a digital asset without token/right evidence.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction
rules.scope_counterexample: Customer crypto held in custody does not become provider-owned asset from private-key access alone.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity has current/deferred income-tax consequences under a specified tax jurisdiction and reporting basis.
rules.exclusion_condition: Sales tax, payroll withholding and donor restrictions are not income-tax provision evidence.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A nonprofit exemption claim still requires jurisdiction and legal-entity evidence.

rules.applicability_trigger: A sale, use, VAT, excise or customs event has a taxable place, item/service classification and effective regime.
rules.exclusion_condition: A non-taxable transfer or transaction outside the selected jurisdiction/regime does not trigger the family.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: Texas prepared-food tax and UK VAT registration are jurisdiction-specific, not universal restaurant rules.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity or individual has a filing, information-return or authorization obligation for a specified jurisdiction and period.
rules.exclusion_condition: A transaction record without a filing obligation or correct taxpayer identity does not trigger a return workflow.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A hospital payer remittance is not itself an income-tax return.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity has cross-border related-party, permanent-establishment, withholding or transfer-pricing facts.
rules.exclusion_condition: Domestic dealings with no cross-border element do not trigger international tax analysis.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A UK hotel serving foreign guests has no transfer-pricing issue solely from guest nationality.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity changes or selects a tax accounting method, period, consent procedure or book-tax treatment.
rules.exclusion_condition: A book policy change with no tax-method consequence does not trigger this family.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: Changing IFRS revenue presentation is not a U.S. tax accounting-method change by itself.

rules.applicability_trigger: One entity obtains control of a business or combines with another business or joint venture.
rules.exclusion_condition: A vendor contract, asset purchase without a business, or ordinary management agreement does not establish a combination.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A hotel property acquisition may be an asset purchase rather than a business combination.

rules.applicability_trigger: A transaction or balance involves a related person/entity, common control, key management or close family relationship.
rules.exclusion_condition: Common industry, referral or customer relationships without the applicable relationship facts are not related parties.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A hospital and insurer contract is not related-party merely because both participate in care payment.

rules.applicability_trigger: A present legal or constructive obligation from a claim, warranty, restoration, safety or contract fact has uncertain amount/timing.
rules.exclusion_condition: Future operating costs or remote possibilities without a present obligation do not trigger a provision.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A future hotel renovation budget is not a provision absent a present obligation.

rules.applicability_trigger: A non-insurer policyholder has a provision and an insurance reimbursement claim requiring IAS 37 analysis.
rules.exclusion_condition: An insurer measuring issued/reinsurance contracts belongs to IFRS 17 scope; an ordinary uninsured loss has no reimbursement asset.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A clinic’s malpractice reserve and an insurer’s policy liability are different roles.

rules.applicability_trigger: A disposal, restructuring plan, insolvency, covenant breach or distress event creates a specified reporting consequence.
rules.exclusion_condition: A budget reduction or ordinary hiring freeze without a present obligation/decision does not establish restructuring accounting.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A public agency’s appropriation cut is not private insolvency evidence.

rules.applicability_trigger: Operations create restoration, remediation, emissions, environmental-credit or contaminated-site obligations/assets.
rules.exclusion_condition: An ordinary office service with no environmental obligation or instrument does not trigger the family.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A 924 environmental regulator administers a program; a 811 repairer’s waste handling may be a narrower compliance cost.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity receives a government grant, donor contribution or restricted resource with conditions or purpose limitations.
rules.exclusion_condition: Customer consideration, unrestricted commercial borrowing and ordinary appropriations without grant/contribution facts require different analysis.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: IAS 20 government grants do not answer U.S. nonprofit contribution or governmental-fund treatment.

rules.applicability_trigger: A state/local/tribal governmental reporting entity records appropriations, fund restrictions, budget authority or interfund activity.
rules.exclusion_condition: A private hospital, nonprofit shelter or government-operated commercial service is not assigned governmental-fund accounting from NAICS alone.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A state health administrator in 923 differs from a private 621 clinic delivering reimbursed care.

rules.applicability_trigger: A U.S. federal reporting entity has appropriations, federal stewardship, component reporting or sovereign budget/accrual requirements.
rules.exclusion_condition: State/local, private and foreign entities do not enter federal GAAP from public funding alone.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A city police department and a federal national-security agency require different authority evidence.

rules.applicability_trigger: An entity issues insurance or reinsurance contracts and assumes insurance risk as an insurer.
rules.exclusion_condition: A policyholder, broker, administrator or healthcare provider does not apply issuer accounting without risk-transfer/issuer facts.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A hospital’s purchased malpractice policy is policyholder accounting, not IFRS 17 issuer accounting.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity lends, accepts deposits, services loans or manages credit exposure as principal/intermediary.
rules.exclusion_condition: An ordinary trade receivable or grant advance is not lending/deposit intermediation without contract and balance-sheet role facts.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: An HMO capitation receivable is not a deposit solely because cash is collected in advance.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity holds client, patient, resident, wager or fiduciary funds/securities or has authority to obtain possession.
rules.exclusion_condition: A provider’s own cash or ordinary customer prepayment is not fiduciary custody without ownership/authority evidence.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: SEC adviser custody and a casino cage are distinct regimes; neither imports IFRS 9 segregation automatically.

rules.applicability_trigger: A regulator permits recovery of specified costs/revenues through rates and the entity is an eligible regulated operator.
rules.exclusion_condition: A licensed business or government regulator without rate-setting/recovery facts does not trigger rate-regulated accounting.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A 926 utility regulator is not the regulated utility recognizing rate adjustments.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity controls, develops or extracts mineral, oil/gas, timber or biological resources.
rules.exclusion_condition: A service provider to an extractor without resource control does not apply resource accounting solely from customer industry.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction
rules.scope_counterexample: A fuel distributor’s inventory is not an extractive reserve.

rules.applicability_trigger: A payer reimburses an entity for eligible care, grant, cost, student aid or contractual program spending.
rules.exclusion_condition: Ordinary customer consideration or a donation with no reimbursement condition does not trigger reimbursement analysis.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration
rules.scope_counterexample: Medicare episode reimbursement and a donor-restricted grant differ in payer rights and conditions.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity licenses, owns, exploits or pays for copyrighted, patented, branded or other protected content rights.
rules.exclusion_condition: A noncopyright software service, customer-owned garment or ordinary tangible inventory does not trigger licensed-content analysis.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction
rules.scope_counterexample: A 533 publisher’s license portfolio differs from a 722 restaurant’s recipe and menu operations.

rules.applicability_trigger: Shared labor, facilities, technology or overhead must be assigned to projects, programs, products, grants or funds.
rules.exclusion_condition: A single-purpose transaction with no shared cost object does not require allocation methodology.
required_facts: legal employer, worker classification, time/benefit population and cost object
rules.scope_counterexample: A public grant allocation and a restaurant recipe cost are different cost-object designs.

rules.applicability_trigger: Management or a public body prepares budgets, forecasts, scenarios or resource plans for a specified decision.
rules.exclusion_condition: A historical ledger close is not a forecast merely because it includes estimates.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A government appropriation budget and a hotel occupancy forecast need different decision owners.

rules.applicability_trigger: The entity measures margin, utilization, yield, service-line, program or other performance outcomes.
rules.exclusion_condition: A metric without defined numerator, denominator, period and decision use is not a reliable performance measure.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration
rules.scope_counterexample: Patient encounter volume is not hospital profitability without payer and cost attribution.

rules.applicability_trigger: A reviewer tests existence, completeness, accuracy, cutoff, rights or obligations for a specified assertion population.
rules.exclusion_condition: A source citation or classification label alone is not audit evidence for an assertion.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A ticket settlement completeness test differs from a museum collection-rights test.

rules.applicability_trigger: The workflow handles assets, payments, access, estimates or incentives with risk of error or fraud.
rules.exclusion_condition: A low-risk informational lookup with no transaction, asset or authorization path does not establish a control/fraud population.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A casino cage and a school tuition ledger need different fraud scenarios and approvals.

rules.applicability_trigger: A contract, regulator, grant, license, tax regime or special-purpose assurance requirement sets compliance criteria.
rules.exclusion_condition: General good practice without a named criterion, responsible authority and period is not compliance assurance.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A child-care subsidy audit and an SEC custody examination use different criteria.

rules.applicability_trigger: A professional or regulated engagement has independence, competence, confidentiality, documentation or action-authority duties.
rules.exclusion_condition: Internal bookkeeping without a professional engagement or regulated duty does not automatically invoke professional-governance requirements.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A freelance artist and a licensed auditor have different governance obligations.

rules.applicability_trigger: A decision depends on traceable source-to-ledger, claim, filing or report transformations.
rules.exclusion_condition: An unrepeatable narrative or unsupported spreadsheet value cannot satisfy lineage merely because it has a URL.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A hospital claim lineage needs encounter-to-remittance links; a hotel POS lineage needs ticket/order-to-bank links.

rules.applicability_trigger: Documents, APIs, spreadsheets or systems exchange data that affects a transaction, control or reporting output.
rules.exclusion_condition: A static source read with no data transfer or downstream decision does not create an interface requirement.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: An invoice EDI interface and an arXiv research citation have different interface controls.

rules.applicability_trigger: The workflow processes confidential patient, employee, financial, classified, client or credential data.
rules.exclusion_condition: Public aggregate data with no identity, access or secret does not trigger the same security scope.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A 928 classified program and a public museum ticket count require different access controls.

rules.applicability_trigger: An agent is being designed to retrieve, reason over or act on accounting evidence for a defined workflow.
rules.exclusion_condition: Industry classification alone does not prove an agent architecture, tool boundary or production suitability.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A healthcare provider profile does not establish a safe agent action authority.

rules.applicability_trigger: A person must review, approve, override or authorize a consequential accounting, payment, filing or disclosure action.
rules.exclusion_condition: Informational retrieval with no consequential action does not require an approval gate.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship
rules.scope_counterexample: A vendor invoice draft and a government payment release have different approval owners.

rules.applicability_trigger: An accounting agent or workflow is evaluated against a defined task, reference, metric and transfer boundary.
rules.exclusion_condition: A source count or demo success without a benchmark task and independent evidence is not evaluation evidence.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status
rules.scope_counterexample: A spreadsheet benchmark cannot establish clinical-claim or tax-return accuracy.

rules.applicability_trigger: A tool or agent is deployed or operated and has incidents, logs, release checks or independent runtime evidence.
rules.exclusion_condition: A design document or local prototype without deployment evidence does not establish operational behavior.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: A passing local test does not prove a hosted payroll or payment workflow.

rules.applicability_trigger: The corpus or agent reuses source text, data, images, code or annotations under identified rights and provenance.
rules.exclusion_condition: Public accessibility or a URL alone does not grant reuse permission.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
rules.scope_counterexample: Licensed publisher content needs terms evidence; a 533 noncopyright business fact does not become licensed content solely from its source URL.
